title: Compile a scalar loading schedule for a full noncommuting degenerate code
statement: Let dim(C)=d<infinity, B>0, bounded Q>=B*I, bounded G:C->bath, W=Q^-1*G, L=W^*W and D=W^*QW. For H_eta=-B*I+[[eta^2*D,eta*G^*],[eta*G,Q]], there is a monotone piecewise-C2 schedule from eta=0 to1 with ||U_T*V0-exp(i*B*T)*V1||op <=[2(d+1)*ell+5*ell^2]/(B*T), where V1=(I,-W)^T*(I+L)^-1/2 and ell<=d*pi/2. For G=0 the error is zero. The isometry bound also holds with an arbitrary untouched reference.

requires: Actual finite-dimensional full degenerate bare code, bounded positive finite-band bath and exact completed matrix Hamiltonian; no additional positive bare penalty selecting a proper subcode.
Known W/L and realizable eta*G plus calibrated eta^2*D; closed coherent evolution with well-defined propagator.

assumptions: Uniformity is at fixed d,B across finite-band models, not an unbounded-operator/domain limit or bound on control amplitudes/work/noise.
The norm bound is an amplitude/isometry bound, not a success probability or acquired device capability.
costs: Sufficient T=[2(d+1)*ell+5*ell^2]/(B*epsilon) for isometry error epsilon; computing/preparing the schedule and full counterterm, source precision and gross work remain paid.
contract.units: hbar=1; B*T dimensionless, ell and isometry error dimensionless; actual time/work require the microscopic convention.

body: Use polar W=U*sqrt(L) on its support and Theta=atan(eta*sqrt(L)); V=(cosTheta,-U*sinTheta)^T satisfies V^*V=I, R*V=0 and V^*Vprime=0. Factorization H+B=R^*QR and RR^*>=I give positive excitation gap>=B. With J=U^*Q^-1*U retain product order: chi_top=sinTheta*cosTheta*J*cosTheta and chi_bath=Q^-1*U*cosTheta-U*sinTheta^2*J*cosTheta solve (H+B)*chi=(sinTheta,U*cosTheta)^T. Bound ||chi||<=1/B and ||chi_prime||<=5||Theta_prime||/B. For F(eta)=max_positive_lambda sqrt(lambda)/(1+eta^2*lambda), define ell=int_0^1 F(eta) d eta. The schedule s=int_0^eta F/ell gives ||Theta_prime||=ell and integral||Theta_doubleprime||<=2*d*ell. The derivatives join continuously at envelope switches. Integrating the exact Duhamel identity yields the bound. No Q/L/J commutation is used; zero eigenvalues remain stationary. Do not replace the full code by ker(A) in a larger penalized controller.

Checked rank-deficient polar support, piecewise schedule continuity and actual cross-counterterm calibration boundary.
